title: Dólares or Dollars? Unraveling the Bilingual Prowess of Financial LLMs Between Spanish and English

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance metrics (such as Accuracy, F1 Score, ROUGE, and Exact Match) of various Large Language Models on financial NLP tasks across English and Spanish datasets using the bilingual FLARE-ES benchmark to identify performance disparities and English-centric bias.
